description: This is a Java source file defining the 'PolicyEntryModified' event class within the Eclipse Ditto project. It models an event emitted after a policy entry has been modified, including methods for JSON serialization/deserialization, property access, and equality checks.

classes.name: PolicyEntryModified
classes.description: Immutable event class representing a modification to a PolicyEntry, including JSON serialization, deserialization, and property management.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates new instances of PolicyEntryModified with various parameter combinations, some deprecated. Handles creation with explicit IDs, revisions, timestamps, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a PolicyEntryModified object from a JSON string or JSON object, extracting policy ID and policy entry details.

methods.name: getPolicyEntry
methods.description: Returns the modified PolicyEntry associated with this event.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Provides the JSON representation of the PolicyEntry in the specified schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON Pointer indicating the resource path for this event, based on the policy entry label.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new instance with an updated revision number.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the event-specific payload information to the JSON object builder, based on schema version and predicate.
